title: alyssum gayanum
intro: Alyssum gayanum, commonly known as sweet alyssum, is a flowering plant species in the family Boraginaceae. The plant is known for its tiny white flowers, which are rich in bioactive constituents and possess various health benefits. The leaves and flowers of sweet alyssum have been traditionally used to treat respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to their expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a potential remedy for bronchitis and other respiratory conditions. The therapeutic actions of alyssum gayanum also include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe and calm the skin, reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
